subject: SLA packaging and conditional discount proposal for BrightGrid
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@brightgrid.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: SLA and premium support options for pilot + committed pricing

Connor —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're preparing an internal ask to move from trial to a paid pilot and need final clarity on two things before procurement signs off: 1) precise response/triage windows (we operate EU business hours but require predictable escalation outside of that window for sev1); and 2) whether you can tie a volume/commitment discount to an uptime SLA (we're targeting 99.95% but want an economics-based credit schedule).

Can you send over a brief matrix and a PO-friendly summary we can share with finance? Also flag any dependencies (e.g., dedicated capacity, geo pins).

—Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Platform, BrightGrid
amy@brightgrid.ai

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.io>
To: Amy Chen <amy@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.io>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.io>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support options for pilot + committed pricing

Hi Amy —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can map a conditional discount to committed inference-hours and structure an escalation credit ladder for uptime that scales with the commitment. High-level summary attached — see RG_SLA_Matrix_BrightGrid_v1.xlsx. Key points:

- Response windows (definitions):
  • Sev1 (production down / critical degradation): 1 hour initial response (phone + Slack), 4 hour remediation target for hosted deployments; 1 hour remediation target with Dedicated.
  • Sev2 (major impact): 4 hour initial response, 24 hour remediation target.
  • Sev3 (minor): next-business-day response.

- Escalation coverage: 24/7 on-call for Sev1 included with Premium Plus. For EU-only coverage during the pilot we can offer an M-F 08:00–18:00 CET SRE coverage plus a paid on-call addendum for overnight/weekend pager at a reduced hourly rate.

- Credit schedule (attached spreadsheet): credits increase non-linearly for higher committed tiers — e.g., at 5,000 committed inference-hours/month you get a 10% unit discount and a base 99.95% SLA; at 15,000 hours a 17% discount and 99.97% SLA ladder with smaller credits. Credits are applied to monthly invoice as a percentage rebate (PO-friendly).

- Pilot option: 6-week pilot with limited SLA (99.9%) and capped credits; if you convert to a 3-month commit within 30 days of pilot completion, we'll backdate preferred pricing to the pilot start.

I looped Vanessa and Jordan on pricing and ops handoff. Vanessa — can you attach the commit-ladder calculator and call out any constraints (e.g., minimum commit, geo pin requirements)?

Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.io>, Amy Chen <amy@brightgrid.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:23:00Z
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support options for pilot + committed pricing

Amy / team —

Attached: commit-ladder-calculator.csv and an updated SLA matrix. A few items to note for procurement/finance:

- Minimum commitment: 3,000 inference-hours/month for the discounted tiers (we can prorate first month).
- Billing model: monthly invoice with a usage true-up; discounts apply against committed units. Overages billed at list-units unless you elect auto-burst credits.
- Escalation credits: credits are applied proportionally to affected region and month. For multi-region failover events we cap aggregate credits at 25% of monthly committed spend.
- Data residency: For EU-only residency, Dedicated or Private placement is required for persistent KV caching of EU-only prefixes. This impacts our remediation targets for some failover modes — callout included in sheet.

If procurement wants explicit PO language I can draft an addendum. Also adding Karthik to flag any legal/tech constraints around SLA definitions and whether we should limit SLA to production routes only.

-Vanessa
VP, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Amy Chen <amy@brightgrid.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.io>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.io>
Cc: procurement@brightgrid.ai
Date: 2026-11-03T13:40:00Z
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support options for pilot + committed pricing

Thanks — helpful. A few clarifying Qs from procurement and finance:

1) For the pilot, can you confirm whether the limited SLA (99.9%) still gives us the same escalation path (phone + Slack) for Sev1? Procurement wants to know if the contactability is reduced or just the credit caps.
2) The non-linear credit ladder: can credits be paid as invoice rebates OR as an uptime credit applied to future invoices? Finance prefers invoice rebates; legal prefers explicit language that credits are the sole remedy.
3) PO instructions: we need a one-line billing description and the DocuSign-ready addendum to attach to the PO packet.

If you can reply with one consolidated response and the DocuSign link, we can get procurement to issue a soft PO for the pilot this week.

—Amy

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.io>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.io>
Date: 2026-11-05T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support options for pilot + committed pricing

Amy — quick consolidated reply below, and the DocuSign link at the end for the pilot addendum. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if you prefer.

1) Pilot contactability: the pilot includes identical escalation paths (phone + Slack) for Sev1; the only difference is the credit cap and the default SLA number (99.9%). So operationally you get the same phone/escalation experience.

2) Credit settlement: we prefer invoice rebates (applied to the invoice in which the impacted month sits) and will include language that credits are the sole financial remedy for SLA breaches. If you need credits paid out as a future balance instead, we can add language to permit that by mutual written agreement (calls out invoice timing).

3) PO and billing descriptor: use this one-liner on the PO — "Redwood Inference: Hosted LLM inference subscription (Pilot) — SLA addendum attached". DocuSign link to addendum (pilot + conditional discount terms): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0a1b2c3d4e5f6g.

Next steps:
- If procurement issues a soft PO for the pilot we will spin up EU-hosted pilot capacity within 48 hours of PO receipt.
- Vanessa will draft a concise PO addendum and Karthik can validate SLA legal language.

Attachments referenced: RG_SLA_Matrix_BrightGrid_v1.xlsx, commit-ladder-calculator.csv

Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
